title: E2E Share a Technical Insight
description: Share one valuable AI or technical resource with the original source and your own analysis.
requirements: Original source | Personal analysis | Relevant to SpoonOS or community builders
review_criteria: Source relevance | Personal insight | Community value
disqualifiers: Link-only post | Generic AI summary | Duplicate source
topic_definition: AI or technical developments that can help SpoonOS community members
positive_examples: Clear source plus a concrete takeaway for SpoonOS
negative_examples: Only says this is good without analysis

title: E2E Submit a Product Improvement Proposal
description: Submit a product suggestion that includes the problem plus proposed solution and expected impact.
requirements: Problem statement | Proposed solution | Expected impact | Evidence from real usage
review_criteria: Specificity | Feasibility | User value | Evidence quality
required_evidence: Screenshot demo or clear reproduction context
disqualifiers: Vague preference | No clear problem | No expected impact
topic_definition: SpoonOS product experience improvements based on real usage
positive_examples: Problem plus proposed change and measurable outcome

title: E2E Repost an Official X Post
description: Repost or quote a designated SpoonOS X post and add a meaningful comment.
requirements: Interaction link | Meaningful comment | Related to the designated account or post
review_criteria: Target match | Comment quality | Evidence validity
disqualifiers: Private or inaccessible link | Unrelated account | Emoji-only comment
topic_definition: SpoonOS official social posts and campaign announcements
positive_examples: A quote repost explaining why the update matters

title: E2E Improve Community FAQ
description: Improve one community FAQ or onboarding guide so new members can complete tasks with less confusion.
requirements: Before and after content | Reason for the change | Expected impact on new members
required_evidence: Document link or screenshot of changes
disqualifiers: Minor wording only | AI-generated generic FAQ | No before-after evidence
topic_definition: Community onboarding and contribution workflow documentation
positive_examples: Adds a missing step with screenshots and a clear user benefit
